app.name: Galmee Clinic
app.tagline: Find any patient's history in 3 seconds instead of searching the folder room.

auth.checkEmail: Check your email and open the link to confirm your account, then log in.
auth.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.errorPassword: Password must be at least 10 characters.

onboarding.title: Set up your clinic
onboarding.intro: Name your clinic to start your own patient records.
onboarding.error: Could not create the clinic. Please try again.
onboarding.errorPhone: Enter an Ethiopian phone number, for example 0911 234 567.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.load: This page could not load. Check your connection and try again.
errors.form: Check the form and try again.
errors.phone: Enter an Ethiopian phone number, for example 0911 234 567.
errors.not_allowed: Your role cannot do this. Ask a manager.
errors.overpayment: That is more than the patient owes.

patients.title: Patients
patients.resultsFor: {count, plural, =0 {No patients} one {# patient} other {# patients}} for “{q}”
patients.noMatch: No patient matches. Check the spelling or register a new patient.
patients.empty: No patients yet. Register the first one to give them card number 1.
patients.searchHint: Showing the newest {count}. Search to find anyone else.
patients.registered: Registered. Card number {cardNo}: write it on the patient's card.
patients.newIntro: The card number is given automatically.
patients.errorPhone: Enter an Ethiopian phone number, for example 0911 234 567, or leave it empty.
patients.errorAge: Enter the age as a whole number of years, 0 to 120.
patients.errorGeneric: Could not register the patient. Please try again.

queue.title: Today's queue
queue.empty: Nobody in the queue yet. Find or register a patient and add them to today's queue.
queue.addError: Could not add to the queue. Try again.

visit.cancelConfirm: Cancel this visit? The patient leaves today's queue. Use this when they went home without being seen.
visit.errorNotAllowed: Only the owner or a manager can cancel a visit that already has services on it.
visit.noServices: No services on this visit yet.
visit.noPriceList: The price list is empty. The owner adds services under Prices.
visit.billErrorLab: A lab test on this visit has no result yet. Enter the result first.
visit.billLabWaiting: Waiting for a lab result before billing.
visit.billErrorOver: More than the total. Enter the amount the patient pays.
visit.billErrorBalance: Only the owner or a manager can leave part of the bill on credit. Take the full amount.
visit.billErrorReference: Enter the Telebirr transaction number from the patient's SMS.
visit.billErrorAmount: Enter the amount in birr, for example 150 or 150.50.
visit.labsNone: No lab tests ordered on this visit.
visit.labsNoPriceList: No lab tests on the price list. The owner adds them under Prices with type Lab test.
visit.labErrorNotAllowed: Only a doctor can order lab tests.
visit.labErrorNotFound: This test is no longer on the price list.

services.title: Services and prices
services.intro: Every visit is billed from this list. Reception sees the prices but cannot change them.
services.empty: No services yet. Add consultation, lab tests and procedures with their prices.
services.emptyStaff: No services yet. Ask the owner to add the price list.
services.name: Service name
services.errorName: Enter a service name of at least 2 letters.
services.errorPrice: Enter the price in birr, for example 150 or 150.50.
services.errorDuplicate: A service with this name already exists.
services.errorNotAllowed: Only the owner or a manager can change prices.

lab.title: Lab
lab.intro: Tests waiting for a result, oldest first.
lab.notAllowed: Only lab staff and doctors can see lab tests.
lab.empty: No tests waiting. New orders from the doctor appear here.
lab.waiting: Waiting for the lab to enter the result.
lab.save: Save results and send back to doctor
lab.errorNotAllowed: Only lab staff can enter results.
lab.errorClosed: This test already has its result.
lab.errorDuplicate: Each test item can appear only once.
lab.errorInvalid: Fill in the test item and result on every line.
